subject: Your M'Arte password has been changed
preview: Your password was changed and every device was signed out of your account.
heading: Password changed
message: The password for your M'Arte account has just been changed with a reset link sent to this address.
messageSecondary: To keep your account safe, we have signed it out on every device. Sign in again with your new password.
security: If you did not change your password, someone may have access to this inbox. Change your email password first, then choose “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page to set a new one, and reply to this email so we can help secure your account.
